checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One ~10s landscape video with music embedded
must.why: MP4 is 10 s, 826x496 landscape, has an audio track (peak -1.8 dB).

must.item: Neon signs, moving train, wet reflections in night city
must.why: All visible in every frame: neon signs, elevated train with motion blur, glossy wet street reflections.

must.item: Upbeat electronic instrumental bed, no speech/singing
must.why: Audio is present with a healthy level, but I can't hear it, so genre, mood and absence of vocals can't be judged.

must.item: At least two distinct shot changes on audible beats
must.why: All sampled frames show the same single camera setup, a static street shot. There is no visible cutting between different city shots.

must.item: No added titles, captions or subtitles
must.why: No overlay text. The neon signs carry pseudo-characters, but these are part of the scene, not captions.

faults.what: The video is one continuous shot from the still. It has no cuts between neon, train and reflection shots, so the request to cut on the beat is not met.
Neon signs carry garbled pseudo-Japanese characters, which are AI artefacts. They are scene signage, not overlays.
The train is a smeared blur and the cars show some warping. Motion is mild, mostly cars drifting.

summary: The result is a good-looking, single-shot rainy neon street with an elevated train and wet reflections, but it has no beat-synced cuts between different shots, so it is not the montage requested.
